description: Simple data analysis with lists, dicts, and readable summaries
author: VIBE IDE Team

loadData.pattern: Lists of dicts or CSV-style rows

aggregate.codeSnippet:
scores = [r["score"] for r in rows]
avg = sum(scores) / len(scores)
best = max(rows, key=lambda r: r["score"])

aiGuidance.tone: Clear and practical; show the number then what it means
aiGuidance.avoid: pandas/numpy unless the project already uses them
